articles.title: Here is why a massive $1.6 billion in crypto liquidity is sitting idle and wasting away
articles.snippet: About $542 million weekly sat outside active trading ranges, meaning this capital earned zero fees and provided no market depth.

articles.title: Tokenization has become a strategic priority for 84% of financial firms
articles.snippet: A Broadridge survey found Wall Street is accelerating tokenization efforts while betting on hybrid markets where digital and traditional assets coexist.

articles.title: Risk-off wave drags bitcoin below $63,000 as AI selloff spreads from stocks to crypto
articles.snippet: Crypto fell as AI stock fatigue and U.S.-Iran tensions weighed on sentiment, though a technical measure hints at oversold conditions heading into the weekend.

articles.title: Galaxy lands 15-year Texas Tech stadium naming rights deal
articles.snippet: Galaxy Digital will rename Texas Tech’s football stadium under a 15-year agreement, expanding its West Texas presence as the state attracts growing crypto investment.

articles.title: Trump Media sells Wall Street low-latency access to Trump posts
articles.snippet: The paid Truth API is aimed at high-frequency trading firms seeking “the fastest” access to market-moving Truth Social posts, including those from US President Donald Trump.
